name: After The Bell Rings
source: After The Bell Rings is the story of Mana and Sayaka, two young adults whose roads suddenly crossed one night. Mana is an English teacher in High School and Sayaka is a punk-rock free spirit who wants nothing but make Mana's life more enjoyable. But being an adult in love is not as easy at one might think...
translation: 《钟声响起之后》讲述玛娜与沙耶香的故事：两个年轻人的人生在某个夜晚突然交会。玛娜是高中英语教师，沙耶香则是朋克摇滚风格、只想让玛娜活得更快乐的自由灵魂。然而，成年人的恋爱并没有想象中那么简单……
